events.title: Indian Shares End Notably Higher As Oil Prices Retreat
events.description: Indian shares reversed course to end notably higher on Monday as investors closely monitored the situation in the Middle East and awaited an upcoming Federal Reserve interest-rate decision.

events.title: German Equities Rally On Oil Price Decline, Economic Optimism
events.description: German stocks gained as oil prices fell 1.5% on West Asia diplomatic efforts. Bayer led gainers with a 3.4% jump, while Germany's October business climate index reached its highest level since May 2023.

events.title: Gold Edges Higher As Oil Prices Retreat After Nearing Six-month Highs
events.description: Gold edged higher on Monday as investors closely monitored the situation in the Middle East and awaited an upcoming Federal Reserve interest-rate decision.

events.title: Oil Prices Retreat From Near Six-month Highs On Hopes For Diplomacy
events.description: Oil prices fell more than 2 percent on Monday after reports of diplomatic efforts to reduce regional tensions in West Asia.

events.title: European Shares Rise As Oil Prices Retreat From Near Six-month Highs
events.description: European stocks were modestly higher on Monday as easing oil prices provided some relief and investors looked forward to a slew of central bank meetings as well key tech earnings for directional cues.

events.title: NZ Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The New Zealand dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Monday.

events.title: Asian Shares Mixed Ahead Of Central Bank Meetings, Tech Earnings
events.description: Asian stocks ended mixed on Monday due to renewed tensions in the Middle East and ahead of earnings from major U.S. technology companies due this week.

events.title: European Shares Seen Higher At Open As Oil Prices Retreat
events.description: European stocks are seen opening broadly higher on Monday as oil prices retreated and focus shifted to several key central bank decisions, including the U.S. Federal Reserve's latest monetary policy meeting later in the week.

events.title: Indian Shares Open Lower In Cautious Trade
events.description: Indian shares were moving lower in early trade on Monday amid renewed concerns over elevated oil prices and caution ahead of the U.S. Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision, due later in the week.

events.title: Australian Market Swings To Slight Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is swinging its slight gains in mid-market trading on Monday after opening in the red, extending the slight gains in the previous session, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street on Friday. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is moving above the 8,800.00 level, with gains in mining and technology stocks partially offset by weakness in financial stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Track Wall Street Lower
events.description: Asian stock markets are trading mostly lower on Monday, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street on Friday, on rising oil prices and global inflation worries amid uncertainty in the Middle East conflict. Traders also remain cautious ahead of the interest rate decision this week from the central banks in the US, Japan and the Eurozone. Asian markets closed mixed on Friday.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Opening On Muted Note
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening on a muted note on Monday as investors closely monitor the situation in the Middle East and await an upcoming Federal Reserve interest-rate decision.

events.title: Lower Open Tipped For Thai Stock Market
events.description: Ahead of Friday's holiday for King Chulalongkorn Memorial Day, the Thai stock market has moved higher in back-to-back sessions, climbing more than 7 points or 0.4 percent in that span. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,560-point plateau although it may tick lower on Monday.
